name: Shizuhara Yumika
source:
An innocent and pure girl protagonist met in the park. 
Her parents work late and thus there is no one at home so she comes to park everyday. 

Her parents' workplace reassigned frequently so she has to move from place to place and hence has trouble making friends.

"Fairy-san, can I call you onii-chan?"
